title: 第23章 张开粉唇等待投喂的绝美师尊第24章 江魔头的惩罚香汗淋漓的大逆徒
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
“不算好吧，关系只能算一般！”
江尘羽犹豫了片刻，最终还是没敢把三个徒弟中两个想杀自己而后快的事情告诉自己的师尊。
“那你还想着把师尊这儿的东西带过去给她们！”
谢曦雪的语气十分平静，但是哪怕江尘羽再愚钝，也知道自己的这一行径引起了师尊的不满。
于是乎，他朝着谢曦雪拱了拱手，随后满脸认真地说道：
“徒儿只是想到，在徒儿还小的时候，师尊每次外出都会给徒儿带东西，所以这才......”
“虽然徒儿无法像师尊一样，成为全天下最好的师尊，但是徒儿还是想对自己的弟子稍微好一些。”
作为资深的恋爱游戏玩家，江尘羽自然知道这个时候该夸夸自己的美女师尊。
不过在说这话的时候，江尘羽也没有觉得自己是在骗人。
毕竟，自家绝美师尊除了偶尔会严厉地瞪自己几下外，其他地方都堪称无可挑剔。
“行吧，你既然都这样说了，那你就把那些盒子带回去吧！”
“不过下不为例，你要是真想给她们带吃的，你就回你院子里给她们弄，食材由我来负责！”
“从今往后，尘羽你在师尊这里做的吃的，只准由师尊我或者是尘羽你吃！”
“要是你之后还敢偷偷摸摸送给别人，那就别怪为师我惩罚你了！”
“是，师尊！”
闻言，江尘羽点了点头，随后将规矩记在了心头。
......
“鲜，太鲜了，这鱼简直了......”
将一块如玉般散发着温润灵力的鱼肉给夹起送入口中，江尘羽的眼睛都不禁惬意地眯了起来。
这顶级食材就是哪怕是生吃都是香的嘞，更何况是经历过江师傅加工的。

“师尊，吃啊，你怎么不吃呢？”
“它离我太远了！”
在江尘羽见了鬼的目光中，谢曦雪只是用筷子夹着自己面前的蔬菜。
以您的能力，就算是十里外的敌人都能够凭借灵识与灵力当场击杀。
您说您夹不到桌子另一头的鱼肉，这句话说出来您自己信吗？
“那......那我夹给您？”
犹豫了片刻，江尘羽最终还是颇有孝心地说道。
“可！”
听到这话，绝美师尊满意地点了点头，随后张开了自己粉嫩的嘴唇。
闻言，江尘羽立即起身，随后夹了一片汁水最足，看上去也最鲜嫩的鱼肉递了过去。
“好吃！”
将筷子上的鱼肉给吃下腹部，谢曦雪的眼眸浮现起一抹亮光。
随后在江尘羽震撼的目光下，美人师尊居然还伸出柔软粉嫩的舌头在筷子上舔了下，似乎是不想浪费其上鲜甜的料汁。
回到了座位上，江尘羽看着那筷子陷入了沉思。
犹豫了片刻，他询问道：
“师尊，咱这有没有新的筷子！”
“没有！”
谢曦雪回复得斩钉截铁的，根本没有商量的余地。
“徒儿你嫌弃我？”
虽然对自己刚刚那个动作也感到十分羞耻，但是在看到江尘羽久久都没有动筷的时候，谢曦雪还是忍不住凶凶地说了一句。

“没！”
闻言，江尘羽也顾不得那么多了，继续开始大快朵颐了起来。
待酒饱饭足之后，他惬意地眯了眯眼睛，随后在想起什么后，他才说道：
“师尊，徒儿明天就不来给您请安了！”
“为何？”
content_en:
"It's not good, the relationship can only be considered average!"
Jiang Chenyu hesitated for a moment, but in the end he did not dare to tell his master that two of the three apprentices wanted to kill him and then quickly.
"Then you still want to bring Master's things to them!"
Xie Xixue's tone was very calm, but no matter how stupid Jiang Chenyu was, he knew that his behavior had aroused the dissatisfaction of his master.
As a result, he cupped his hands towards Xie Xixue, and then said seriously:
"The disciple just thought that when the disciple was young, the master would bring things for the disciple every time he went out, so this is why..."
"Although the disciple cannot become the best master in the world like the master, the disciple still wants to be a little better to his disciples."
As a veteran love game player, Jiang Chenyu naturally knew that this was the time to praise his beautiful master.
But when he said this, Jiang Chenyu didn't feel that he was lying.
After all, except for occasionally sternly glaring at me, my beautiful master was impeccable in everything else.
"Okay, since you said so, just take those boxes back!"
"But this will not happen next time. If you really want to bring them food, you can go back to your yard and get it for them. I will be responsible for the ingredients!"
"From now on, the food Chen Yu you cook at Master's place can only be eaten by Master me or Chen Yu!"
"If you dare to secretly give it to others in the future, then don't blame me for punishing you!"
"Yes, Master!"
Hearing this, Jiang Chenyu nodded, and then remembered the rules in his heart.
...
"Fresh, so fresh, this fish is simply..."
Picking up a piece of fish meat that exuded warm spiritual power like jade and putting it into his mouth, Jiang Chenyu couldn't help but narrow his eyes with pleasure.
This top-quality ingredient is delicious even when eaten raw, not to mention it has been processed by Master Guo Jiang.
"Master, eat, why don't you eat?"
"It's too far away!"
Under Jiang Chenyu's ghostly gaze, Xie Xixue just picked up the vegetables in front of her with chopsticks.
With your ability, even enemies ten miles away can be killed on the spot with spiritual knowledge and spiritual power.
You said you couldn't pick up the fish from the other side of the table. Do you believe it?
"Then...then I'll give it to you?"
After hesitating for a moment, Jiang Chenyu finally said filially.
"Yes!"
Hearing this, the beautiful master nodded with satisfaction, and then opened his pink lips.
Hearing this, Jiang Chenyu immediately stood up, then picked up a piece of the juiciest and most tender-looking fish and handed it over.
“Delicious!”
After eating the fish meat on the chopsticks, Xie Xixue's eyes flashed with light.
Then, under Jiang Chenyu's shocked gaze, the beautiful master even stretched out his soft pink tongue and licked the chopsticks, as if he didn't want to waste the fresh and sweet juice on them.
Returning to his seat, Jiang Chenyu looked at the chopsticks and fell into deep thought.
After hesitating for a moment, he asked:
"Master, do we have new chopsticks?"
"No!"
Xie Xixue replied categorically, leaving no room for negotiation.
"Disciple, do you dislike me?"
Although he felt very ashamed of his action just now, when he saw Jiang Chenyu not moving his chopsticks for a long time, Xie Xixue couldn't help but say something fierce.
"No!"
Hearing this, Jiang Chenyu didn't care so much anymore and continued to eat happily.
After he was full of wine and food, he squinted his eyes in contentment, and then after thinking of something, he said:
"Master, my disciple will not come to greet you tomorrow!"
"Why?"
